whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Bawarchi Food & Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant is well-positioned near the Patna Junction area in Karbigahiya, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for direct table reservations and food delivery inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp ordering, menu showcase, aur instant location navigation integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bawarchi

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Bawarchi Food & Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and mobile-first menu access for customers around Patna Junction. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
